author: Inside Edition
description: When cops in San Diego got a report of a home intruder who had climbed through a second- story window, they called in a special assist: a drone. The unwitting suspect got quite the shock when he found himself being chased through the house, not by a human, but by the officer drone. Inside Edition's Jim Moret is at the southern California home with the latest.
title: Suspect Chased By Police Drone

author: Inside Edition
description: A huge debate is raging across the nation over artificial intelligence and whether it will prompt the downfall of civilization. As safety issues are variously discussed and ignored, artificial intelligence products are gaining purchase throughout society, including in entertainment. The new movie "Misaligned" 'stars' an AI creation called Tilly Norwood. The so-called 'actress,' who doesn't exist in human form, spoke with Inside Edition's Steven Fabian.
title: Steven Fabian Interviews Artificial Intelligence Creation

author: Inside Edition
description: Is this tackle worthy of the NFL? The York Regional Police in Ontario, Canada say it was a beautiful tackle with a blindside approach. According to officials, this motorcyclist fled the scene of an accident without exchanging information. The department says an officer advised him that he was under arrest, yet he left anyway. When the motorcyclist came to a stop at an intersection, the officer seized his opportunity. Inside Edition Digital’s Mara Montalbano has more.
title: Cop Tackles Suspect On Motorcycle

author: Inside Edition
description: The band Television has been hailed by fans and critics for its pioneering sound during the New York City punk and new wave movement of the 1970s  Now, legendary guitarist Richard Lloyd is asking fans for help in the fight of his life. Earlier this year, he was diagnosed with cholangiocarcinoma, a rare bile duct cancer. The 74-year-old musician has been in and out of the ICU this year with issues brought on by the cancer, and is now struggling to pay bills. A GoFundMe has been launched to help him and his wife pay for expenses - https://www.gofundme.com/f/help-richard-lloyd-fight-cancer
title: Legendary Punk Guitarist Is Struggling To Pay Bills Amid Rare Cancer Battle

author: Inside Edition
description: We recently told you about a dog that was found by an Ohio state trooper on the side of a highway. Now there is some good news. The dog has a new home with another law enforcement member. Sgt. Matthew Denton of the Medina County Sheriff's Office adopted the pup and named it Trooper. Denton says anyone who can't care for an animal should surrender it to their local SPCA or an animal shelter.
title: Dog Found By Trooper On Ohio Highway Has New Home With Another Cop

author: Inside Edition
description: A suspect, handcuffed in the back of a police car, kicked out the window and tried to make a run for it according to a sheriff in Texas. Video from the back of the car shows his frantic fight for freedom. The Houston County Sheriff says due to the suspect's size of 260 pounds, two sets of handcuffs were used to restrain him. Authorities say he was able to maneuver his hands from behind his back to his front, then began kicking the window. Inside Edition Digital’s Mara Montalbano has more.
title: Suspect Kicks Out Window Of Patrol Car, Makes Run For Freedom: Cops
